LISTENING GUIDE / VOL. 01

Four songs. Four ways in.

Four songs I want more people to hear: two bands, two solo artists, and a different story with each.

01 / YdBB

ONCE

On “ONCE”, released in October 2023, YdBB turn toward the moment of letting someone go — and the wish to be remembered kindly. Yu Dabin describes that farewell in the band’s release interview.

Listen & read ↗

02 / WhiteUsedSocks

Don’t feel sad

Written and composed by Jung Jaeheon, “Don’t feel sad” was released in June 2017. It belongs to the early part of WhiteUsedSocks’ catalogue, before releases such as The Little Match Boy and Through Yearning.

Listen & read ↗

03 / Motte

Don’t run away

Singer-songwriter Motte’s “Don’t run away” appeared on the soundtrack to the Korean web drama A-TEEN in September 2018. You can start with the song whether or not you have seen the series.

Listen & read ↗

04 / HANRORO

Even if you leave

Written and composed by HANRORO, “Even if you leave” (자처) was released in April 2023. The song reflects on attachment and self-blame, and the slow work of carrying on after something has ended.
